$comment: Classification baseline for scripts/audit-duplication.mjs --check (barwise-871). Every detected candidate carries a verdict: accepted-benign (repetition that is not one decision, or a checked/guarded copy) or tracked:<issue> (an open, detectable finding). --check fails on a candidate missing here AND on an entry no longer detected, so the tracked entries always enumerate exactly the open detectable findings, and resolving one forces removing its row and closing its issue. Rubric and method: .claude/skills/duplication-audit/.
